name: Purple Shift
summary:
Purple Shift is a psychological mystery visual novel set in a world touched by an anomalous phenomenon known as the Purple Storm.

What begins as an ordinary shift slowly starts to fracture. Familiar places feel wrong. Conversations repeat in ways they shouldn't. Memories become unreliable. And somewhere behind it all, something is listening.

Over the course of seven days, your decisions shape the people around you, the information you uncover, and the version of events you ultimately believe.
